qualification: cross-revision ÜHA78 comparator; no factory specification or .11 winding/return-path proof

original_winding_report.author: Heiko_P
original_winding_report.observation: The author describes ÜHA78 high-voltage winding as 36 layers of 66 turns plus one layer of 33 turns, using 0.08 mm enamelled copper wire; outer diameter at most 50 mm, winding over a 25 mm tube.
original_winding_report.evidence_tier: class-typical comparator; firsthand repair account, not factory .11 data

replacement_winding_report.author: Daniel Auerbach
replacement_winding_report.observation: K7222.25 repair winds 26 layers of 68 turns with about 0.10 mm wire and reports about 440 ohms measured DC resistance. It reroutes the replacement cold end to the chassis, so its connection is not the original .11 graph.
replacement_winding_report.evidence_tier: class-typical comparator; measured replacement, not original .11 data

copper_reference.use: Standard annealed-copper resistivity for R = rho * length / area; enamel, copper temperature and effective wire diameter add uncertainty.

derived_comparison.resistance_equation: R = 0.017241 ohm mm2/m * turns * pi * mean_diameter_m / (pi * (0.08 mm)^2 / 4)
derived_comparison.warning: The original diameter bounds are geometry-based estimates, not reported resistance limits. The 25 mm tube and 50 mm maximum outer diameter need not be exact winding mean-diameter endpoints.

active_model_comparison.interpretation: The active 1,000-turn HV hypothesis is below both reported ÜHA78 winding counts. Its 1 kohm DC resistance is within the broad geometry-derived original-winding copper range. The 2,409/64 ideal turn ratio is 1.728 times the corrected conditional EHT/collector proxy upper bound, but the proxy is not an HV/drive winding ratio: X2:4 return voltage, the loaded differential drive pulse and the .11 winding graph are unqualified. Neither the cross-revision turns nor this discrepancy identifies .11 drive turns.

isolated_loaded_sensitivity.setup: t3_return_variants.py flux backend, one accepted sign candidate, tied X1:3/X2:3 return, 1 V/16 us primary pulses, 1 nF EHT load and V21-class diode; all parameters except HV turns held at the active hypothesis
isolated_loaded_sensitivity.interpretation: The HV-turn choice materially changes the isolated loaded result. These low-voltage pulses cannot establish a connected 11–12 kV operating point.
